proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

The corpus is verified before selection; forged records are rejected by the harness.
LessonRules are validated guidance and never become gates.

evidence.intent: Generalize Atomic host proof admission so inherited broker endpoints are trusted only when live; otherwise proofs clear stale sockets or create their own broker fixture, and mandatory-domain proof enforces this stronger invariant instead of preserving dead endpoints.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

proofLimits: Briefing remains proposer guidance, not a gate and not a proof of correctness.
The hard gate remains the only judge; learned lessons may never weaken admission.
The corpus is verified before selection; forged records are rejected by the harness.
LessonRules are validated guidance and never become gates.

evidence.intent: Close the atomic_exec stale broker admission gap by requiring inherited Unix broker endpoints to be live sockets before delegation. A stale inherited endpoint is not a valid capability path and must fail closed instead of causing every atomic_exec invocation to try ENOENT.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

proofLimits: Briefing remains proposer guidance, not a gate and not a proof of correctness.
The hard gate remains the only judge; learned lessons may never weaken admission.
The corpus is verified before selection; forged records are rejected by the harness.
LessonRules are validated guidance and never become gates.

evidence.intent: Generalize Atomic self-validation for monotonic tool growth and host-admitted build temp roots. This addresses the class of failures where adding a safe capability makes smoke fail due a static tool count, and where self-expansion/hot-reload build depends on /tmp even when the controlled host denies mkdtemp there. The change is universal: it does not encode the A/B task, it makes the build choose a writable temp root and makes smoke verify required tools by presence plus monotonic minimum instead of exact cardinality.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

evidence.intent: Generalize Atomic self-validation for monotonic tool growth and host-admitted build temp roots. This addresses the class of failures where adding a safe capability makes smoke fail due a static tool count, and where self-expansion/hot-reload build depends on /tmp even when the controlled host denies mkdtemp there. The change is universal: it does not encode the A/B task, it makes the build choose a writable temp root and makes smoke verify required tools by presence plus monotonic minimum instead of exact cardinality.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

evidence.intent: Round054 A/B showed ALL-IN atomic won traceability and tool-call count but lost badly on time/tokens because default Atomic read/exec surfaces returned medium full files and long validation output. Generalize the Atomic MCP toward compact proof surfaces by making adaptive reads summary-first for medium files with explicit override, and by adding configurable compact stdout/stderr caps to atomic_exec.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

evidence.intent: Repair Atomic proof-host routing and Y certificate proof execution so broker-capable proofs inherit a live Atomic broker, empty host markers do not disable host mode, and internal certificate proof scripts run with scratch-only temp writes instead of whole-repo effectRoot writes. This generalizes the fix for Atomic self-expansion liveness and performance-update admission.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

The corpus is verified before selection; forged records are rejected by the harness.
LessonRules are validated guidance and never become gates.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

LessonRules are validated guidance and never become gates.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

evidence.intent: Fix the Atomic smoke harness so temporary workspaces remain isolated when TMPDIR is sandboxed to the repository root. The smoke currently creates atomic-init-* and atomic-mcp-* directories under /Users/danielpenin/kloel, so atomic-cli repoRoot() ascends to the parent repo and writes governance/MCP manifests in the coordinator checkout instead of the test workspace. Marking those temp directories with .atomic/traces makes repoRoot() stop at the intended workspace and preserves the production CLI contract.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

The hard gate remains the only judge; learned lessons may never weaken admission.
The corpus is verified before selection; forged records are rejected by the harness.
LessonRules are validated guidance and never become gates.

evidence.intent: Implement a bounded shallow directory tree in code_readcode and code_readcode_batch so Atomic ALL-IN workers reduce serial directory navigation calls without leaking source bodies or scanning dependency/build trash.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

proofLimits: Receipt proves deterministic promotion policy over embedded benchmark/gate facts only.
Receipt does not prove that the benchmark suite captures all future product behavior.
Admission proves only structural hard-channel invariants enumerated by the mandatory validator lattice.
Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.

Capability and behavioral correctness remain empirical or unjudged; the receipt must not be sold as semantic corrigibility.
